'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Dan Kim DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Kim]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Endor Ops AT-ST
* '''Username:''' MrNiceGuy
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
